recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: late april spring light stretching toward an eight o'clock sunset
clear eighteen-degree air with wind brisk enough to lift collars
coins leaving faint wakes now visible through polished cryptographic glass
young companies hanging lanterns for their first growth builders
charts twitching where distant commodities answer rumor
headphones carrying stutter kicks between calm meetings

composer-2-fast.concept: Window-seat commute rhythm: platform lights strobe past while you tap only on real kicks, ignoring fake double hits injected by tunnel noise.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm tap with intermittent stutter windows where two taps land inside one beat.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Clearing one tunnel stretch completes a loop that feels like locking a live mix.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Ghost kicks multiply and wind-shake adds brief blind spans.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon smear on train glass, violet fog halos

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick obsidian tokens into prism bins; successful arcs briefly visualize hidden trails before they dissolve.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Physics flick aiming into shrinking targets.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Each arc paints a satisfying translucent ledger streak.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Crosswind vectors tilt trajectories and bins orbit slowly.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Matte coins, glass troughs, spring dusk gradient

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Ride the seam between a pastel dream-pop fog lane and a laser melodic-techno river without letting genres bleed.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Lane switch timed to gap openings.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Sixty seconds of clean swaps keeps the stereo field pristine.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Lanes narrow and tempo ramps tighten swap windows.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one continuous courier path across a watercolor SF spring map linking startup dots without crossing blooming fog pockets.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Path drawing with obstacle avoidance scoring longest stroke.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Connecting three nodes without lifting thumb clears a micro sprint.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog blooms spread and line jitter simulates GPS drift.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Bleached map wash, mint courier trail
